page_title: SCO 0-3 BRA | Scotland v Brazil 24/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+6' Scott McTominay (Scotland) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Alisson who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
90+5' Corner kick. Scotland will have an opportunity.
90+5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Scotland, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+1' Here is a change. John McGinn is going off and Steve Clarke gives the last tactical orders to Findlay Curtis (Scotland).
90+1' Substitution. Che Adams (Scotland) on for Lawrence Shankland.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Neymar (Brazil) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
90' Neymar (Brazil) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
89' Ryan Christie (Scotland) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
89' Anthony Ralston (Scotland) fires a powerful volley towards goal, but his shot lacks accuracy and is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
86' Gabriel (Brazil) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
86' The referee blows his whistle, Brazil are awarded a corner kick.
85' Neymar (Brazil) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
82' Cesar Arturo Ramos shows a yellow card to Fabinho (Brazil), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
82' The substitution has been made. Endrick (Brazil) has replaced Rayan.
82' Here's the change. Douglas Santos leaves the pitch and Alex Sandro (Brazil) comes on as a substitute.
82' Steve Clarke prepares a substitution. Ben Gannon-Doak is replaced by Ryan Christie (Scotland).
82' Nathan Patterson will be replaced by Anthony Ralston (Scotland).
81' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
79' A dangerous looking corner kick from Neymar (Brazil) is cleared to safety by the defence.

79' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) gets inside the box and tries to beat Angus Gunn with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Neymar (Brazil) is brought on as a substitute for Matheus Cunha.
76' Lawrence Shankland (Scotland) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and sends his header just over the bar.
75' The referee points to the corner flag and Scotland will take a corner.
75' Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
75' Kieran Tierney (Scotland) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Scotland.
72' Scott McTominay (Scotland) misses a big opportunity after striking the ball towards goal and it goes just over the crossbar.
71' The attendance is 64478.
68' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
66' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) replaces Lucas Paqueta.
65' Fabinho (Brazil) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Casemiro.
65' Flag up against Vinicius Junior (Brazil). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
64' Alisson makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Scott McTominay (Scotland) after a cross from the side.
64' John McGinn (Scotland) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

64' Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) fires an accurate shot from the free kick towards the roof of the net. His attempt to score is quickly stopped by the goalkeeper. The ball goes behind for a corner. Scotland will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Scotland are awarded a free kick.
62' Danilo (Brazil) sees a yellow card from Cesar Arturo Ramos after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

60' 0 - 3 Goal! Matheus Cunha (Brazil) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Bruno Guimaraes assisted in the goal. 0:3.

59' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post.
59' Matheus Cunha (Brazil) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
56' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Scotland for a penalty. Play continues.
54' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Vinicius Junior (Brazil). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
53' Nathan Patterson (Scotland) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
51' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
49' Scott McTominay (Scotland) leaps highest and connects well with a cross, but his header towards the middle of the goal is well saved by Alisson.
46' Andrew Robertson (Scotland) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Kieran Tierney.
46' Referee Cesar Arturo Ramos blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' Douglas Santos (Brazil) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45+7' Brazil have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45+6' Rayan (Brazil) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the right side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Angus Gunn, who keeps it out. Brazil force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
45+6' Ben Gannon-Doak (Scotland) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+3' 0 - 2 Goal! Bruno Guimaraes picks out Vinicius Junior (Brazil) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the left side of the goal with a header from close range. 0:2.
45+2' Nathan Patterson (Scotland) is penalised for holding. Cesar Arturo Ramos signals a set piece.
45+2' Ben Gannon-Doak (Scotland) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Angus Gunn intercepts the ball.
45' Brazil quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45' Matheus Cunha (Brazil) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block. The ball goes out of play and Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Matheus Cunha (Brazil) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
39' Kenny McLean (Scotland) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
38' A long pass finds Rayan (Brazil) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
36' Kenny McLean (Scotland) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
36' Rayan (Brazil) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Scotland will have a goal kick.
33' Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
33' Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The ball is out of play. Scotland will have a chance to score from a corner.
32' Scotland failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
32' Andrew Robertson (Scotland) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Scotland earn a corner.
29' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Scotland comes to nothing.
25' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
24' Celebrations are cut short for Brazil as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
24' Wait! Referee Cesar Arturo Ramos has indicated he is going to review the Brazil goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
22' Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Vinicius Junior (Brazil), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 0:2.
21' Rayan (Brazil) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
20' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes way wide of the left post.
19' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
18' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brazil.
16' The Brazil players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Matheus Cunha (Brazil) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
11' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Vinicius Junior (Brazil), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
7' Casemiro (Brazil) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
4' Scotland enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
